bio.text: Seth Kuhl-Stennes, of Minneapolis, is the Green Party candidate for Minnesota secretary of state in 2026; the KAXE candidate survey response lists employment as operations specialist at the Land Stewardship Project.

In the KAXE candidate survey response, Kuhl-Stennes listed Baudette as the place of birth and upbringing, a political science degree from the College of Saint Benedict and Saint John's University, and residence in the Twin Cities area since 2006.
